summary: Front of the shirt carries Solverde.pt (Grupo Solverde) with Soleo above it; the back carries AMCO and Lusíadas, the sleeves Tek4life, and the shorts SABSEG and 2045. Puma makes the kit. Grupo Solverde is wholly held by the Violas family holding; Lusíadas sits in France's Vivalto Santé; the rest are Portuguese private companies with no state link found.
